n149d86f69ff.s: Which body determines the minority status of an educational institution and issues minority institution certificates?
o: National Commission for Minority Educational Institutions
n149d86f69ff.x: The NCMEI determines minority status, decides affiliation disputes and issues minority certificates, with civil court powers.

nindian-society-37-18.s: The SEED Scheme Portal for applications from Denotified Tribe communities is administered by the:
nindian-society-37-18.x: The SEED portal, which takes DNT applications for health insurance, coaching and housing, is run by the Department of Social Justice, not the NTA.

n0ca6516d8a6.s: T.M.A. Pai Foundation v. State of Karnataka (2002) was decided by a Bench of:
n0ca6516d8a6.x: An 11-judge Bench made the State the unit for minority status and allowed regulation, not control, of minority institutions.

na1b293f8d55.s: Article 29(2) bars denial of admission to State-aided institutions on grounds only of religion, race, caste or ____.
na1b293f8d55.x: Article 29(2) lists religion, race, caste and language; sex and place of birth are not in this list.

n92af9232db9.s: Linguistic minorities in India are identified:
o: by notification under the NCM Act
by the National Commission for Minorities
n92af9232db9.x: Linguistic minorities are identified State-wise and handled by the Special Officer under Article 350B; religious minorities are dealt with by the NCM.

ne2383779bdd.s: The Special Officer for Linguistic Minorities under Article 350B is appointed by the:
ne2383779bdd.x: Under Article 350B, the Special Officer is appointed by the President and reports to the President.

n8899bfab325.s: Which Article provides for instruction in the mother tongue at the primary stage?
n8899bfab325.x: Article 350A provides for mother-tongue instruction at the primary stage; Article 350B provides for the Special Officer.

na102af2ad77.s: The Idate Commission found about how many Denotified Tribes that had never been classified?
na102af2ad77.x: About 267-268 DNTs had never been classified, while about 1,200 were already in SC, ST or OBC lists.

n952e900fff1.s: Which case held that the State cannot impose reservation on unaided professional institutions?
o: P.A. Inamdar v. State of Maharashtra
T.M.A. Pai Foundation v. State of Karnataka
St. Stephen's College v. University of Delhi
n952e900fff1.x: P.A. Inamdar (2005) barred reservation in unaided institutions; T.M.A. Pai made the State the unit for minority status.

nindian-society-37-20.s: The dashboard for 11 critical interventions across 75 PVTG communities is part of:
nindian-society-37-20.x: The 11-intervention dashboard for 75 PVTGs is PM-JANMAN; Hunar Haat/PM-VIKAS promotes minority artisans.

nindian-society-42-32.s: The Sachar Committee, a Prime Minister's High-Level Committee, was set up in:
nindian-society-42-32.x: The Sachar Committee was set up in March 2005 and reported in November 2006.

n79b51d72c44.s: How many members of the National Commission for Minorities, including the Chairperson, must be from minority communities?
n79b51d72c44.x: The NCM has seven members; five, including the Chairperson, must be from minority communities, so all seven need not be.

nindian-society-11-10.s: The Gopal Singh Committee on minorities submitted its report in:
nindian-society-11-10.x: The Gopal Singh panel on minorities reported in 1983; the Ranganath Misra Commission came in 2004 and Sachar in 2005.

nindian-society-35-22.s: Which minority scheme brings together skill development, artisan support and entrepreneurship?
nindian-society-35-22.x: PM-VIKAS converges skill training, support for artisans and entrepreneurship for minorities.

n62b3c6ce298.s: Under the Code on Social Security, 2020, a person who works through online platforms is a:
n62b3c6ce298.x: A platform worker works through online platforms; a gig worker works outside a traditional employer-employee relationship.

n416adef5d2c.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched under the Industrial Relations Code?
o: Prior permission for layoff, retrenchment and closure – 300 workers
Earlier threshold for layoff permission – 50 workers
n416adef5d2c.x: Prior permission is now needed only for establishments with 300 or more workers (earlier 100); the contract labour threshold rose from 20 to 50.

nf50c356e3a0.s: Which of the following is listed in Schedule I of the Unorganised Workers' Social Security Act, 2008?
nf50c356e3a0.x: Schedule I lists schemes such as the National Family Benefit Scheme, Janani Suraksha Yojana and RSBY; Atal Pension Yojana is not in it.

nbe1543de996.s: Roughly what share of India's about 600 million workers is informal?
nbe1543de996.x: Over 90% of India's roughly 600 million workers are informal; 77% is the NCEUS figure for people living on under Rs 20 a day.

nf35e099c44c.s: Under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, a complaint is deemed admitted if its admissibility is not decided within:
nf35e099c44c.x: A complaint not decided on within 21 days of filing is deemed to have been admitted.

n742db9ba59e.s: The toll-free number of the National Consumer Helpline is:
n742db9ba59e.x: The National Consumer Helpline is reached on 1915; it is a helpline with e-commerce convergence partners, not a court.

n8c1e9d9552a.s: Under Section 21 of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, the penalty for a repeat misleading advertisement may extend to:
n8c1e9d9552a.x: The penalty may extend to Rs 10 lakh for a first offence and Rs 50 lakh for a repeat offence.

n79b28e9930f.s: Under the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020, an e-commerce entity that owns the goods it sells is a(n):
n79b28e9930f.x: An inventory entity owns the goods it sells, whereas a marketplace entity is only a platform; the Rules treat their liabilities differently.

n8b5ad5a9bdf.s: If a consumer dies, who may file a consumer complaint in his or her place?
o: The trader who sold the goods
The legal heir of the consumer
n8b5ad5a9bdf.x: The legal heir of a deceased consumer may file a complaint, and the right is not confined to free medical services.

new.s: Which is the largest notified minority community in India as per Census 2011?
new.x: Muslims form 14.2% of the population (Census 2011), the largest minority; Christians are 2.3% and Sikhs 1.7%.

new.s: The six notified minority communities together make up about what share of India's population?
new.x: The six notified minorities are about 19% of the population; 14.2% is the share of Muslims alone.

new.s: Before Jains were notified by the Centre in 2014, how many States had already declared them a minority?
new.x: States can name their own minorities, and 11 States had declared Jains a minority before 2014.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about notified minority communities:
1. Five communities were notified in 1993.
2. Jews are a notified minority community.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Buddhists and Parsis were notified in 1993 and Jains in 2014; Jews are not notified.

new.s: In re Kerala Education Bill (1958) came before the Supreme Court as a:
o: appeal from the Kerala High Court
new.x: The Kerala Education Bill case was an Article 143 Presidential reference; it held Article 30 is not absolute.

new.s: Which case held that minority institutions may be regulated only for standards and excellence?
o: Bal Patil v. Union of India
P.A. Inamdar v. State of Maharashtra
St. Stephen's College v. University of Delhi
new.x: St. Xavier's College (1974) protected the right to administer and allowed regulation only for standards and excellence.

new.s: P.A. Inamdar v. State of Maharashtra (2005) was decided by a Bench of:
new.x: P.A. Inamdar was a 7-judge Bench; the 11-judge Bench was T.M.A. Pai (2002).

new.s: St. Stephen's College v. University of Delhi (1992) allowed an aided minority college to prefer its own community up to about:
new.x: St. Stephen's held that an aided minority college may prefer its own community up to about 50% of seats.

new.s: Who was the first chairman of the statutory National Commission for Minorities?
new.x: The first statutory NCM (1993) was chaired by Justice Mohammed Sardar Ali Khan; Harjit Singh Grewal is Chairperson in 2026.

new.s: The post of Vice-Chairperson, which made the NCM a seven-member body, was added in:
new.x: A 1995 amendment added the Vice-Chairperson, giving Chairperson + Vice-Chairperson + 5 Members = 7.

new.s: The non-statutory Minorities Commission of 1978 was set up by a resolution of the:
new.x: The 1978 Minorities Commission came by an MHA resolution; the Ministry of Minority Affairs came only in 2006.

new.s: The Ministry of Minority Affairs was created in:
new.x: The Ministry of Minority Affairs was set up in 2006; Haj was added to it in October 2016.

new.s: Statutory State Minorities Commissions exist in how many States/UTs?
new.x: State Minorities Commissions are statutory in 19 States/UTs, including Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.

new.s: What is the tenure of members of the National Commission for Minorities?
new.x: NCM members hold office for 3 years.

new.s: The Post-Sachar Evaluation Committee (2013-14) was chaired by:
new.x: The Kundu Committee under Prof. Amitabh Kundu evaluated the post-Sachar position and found gaps persisting.

new.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched with reference to Muslim groups described by the Sachar Committee?
o: Arzal – claimed foreign or upper-caste origin
Ajlaf – need attention like Hindu OBCs
new.x: Ajlaf (commoners, lower-caste converts) need attention like Hindu OBCs; Arzal are Dalit Muslims and Ashraf the upper group.

new.s: The Sachar Committee studied the socio-economic and educational status of:
new.x: The Sachar Committee (2005-06) studied the socio-economic and educational status of Muslims.

new.s: The Ranganath Misra Commission submitted its report in:
new.x: The Ranganath Misra Commission was constituted in 2004 and reported in 2007.

new.s: The Ranganath Misra Commission recommended what reservation for Muslims?
new.x: It recommended 15% reservation for minorities, of which 10% for Muslims.

new.s: The original 15-Point Programme for minorities was introduced in:
new.x: The original 15-Point Programme dates from 1983; the PM's New 15 Point Programme came in 2006.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT an aim of the PM's New 15 Point Programme?
o: Fair share in jobs and economic activity
new.x: The four aims are education, jobs and economic activity, living conditions and prevention of riots; delinking SC status from religion was a Ranganath Misra recommendation.

new.s: Nai Roshni (2013) is a scheme for:
o: Education and skills for school dropouts
new.x: Nai Roshni is leadership training for minority women; Nai Manzil serves dropouts and Nai Udaan supports those who clear prelims.

new.s: Which minority scheme combines education and skills for school dropouts?
new.x: Nai Manzil (2015) gives education plus skills to school dropouts.

new.s: Which of the following pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Seekho aur Kamao – modern skilling with placement
new.x: Nai Roshni is leadership training for minority women; the scheme for school dropouts is Nai Manzil.

new.s: PM VIKAS and PM Jan Vikas Karyakram are, respectively:
new.x: PM VIKAS is a Central Sector scheme, while PMJVK is Centrally Sponsored.

new.s: What share of PM VIKAS skilling seats is reserved for women?
new.x: PM VIKAS reserves 33% of skilling seats for women; 30% is the PM-YASASVI share for girls.

new.s: Post-matric scholarships for minority students are given to those with family income up to:
new.x: The minority post-matric scholarship has an income ceiling of Rs 2 lakh, paid by DBT through the National Scholarship Portal.

new.s: PM Vishwakarma covers artisans in how many trades?
new.x: PM Vishwakarma, launched on 17 September 2023, covers artisans in 18 trades.

new.s: PM Vishwakarma was launched on Vishwakarma Jayanti in:
new.x: The scheme was launched on 17 September 2023, Vishwakarma Jayanti.

new.s: Which scheme funds SC students in higher education at IITs and IIMs?
new.x: SHREYAS supports higher education and funds 8,571 SC students at IITs and IIMs.

new.s: PM-YASASVI is for OBC, EBC and DNT students with family income below:
new.x: PM-YASASVI (2021) covers OBC/EBC/DNT students with income below Rs 2.5 lakh, with 30% slots for girls.

new.s: NBCFDC and NMDFC lend to beneficiaries through:
new.x: Both NBCFDC and NMDFC lend through State Channelising Agencies.

new.s: NMDFC's Virasat loans are meant for:
new.x: Virasat gives loans to minority artisans; New Swarnima (women) and Saksham (young professionals) are NBCFDC schemes.

new.s: The Criminal Tribes Act, 1871 was repealed in:
new.x: The Criminal Tribes Act, 1871 was repealed in 1952.

new.s: The Waqf (Amendment) Act, 2025 renamed the Waqf Act, 1995 as the:
new.x: With the 2025 Act (assent 5 April 2025), the 1995 Act was renamed the UMEED Act.

new.s: The Central Waqf Council became a statutory body in:
new.x: The Central Waqf Council was set up in 1964 under Section 8A of the 1954 Act; it is now under Section 9 of the 1995 Act.

new.s: The Supreme Court's interim order of September 2025 capped non-Muslim members of a State Waqf Board at:
new.x: The order capped non-Muslims at 3 on a State Board and 4 on the Central Waqf Council.

new.s: Under the Waqf (Amendment) Act, 2025, an appeal lies to the High Court within:
new.x: The 2025 Act provides an appeal to the High Court within 90 days and applies the Limitation Act.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh pays imams a monthly honorarium of:
new.x: AP pays Rs 10,000 a month to imams and Rs 5,000 to muezzins.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh's Shaadi Tohfa (2020) gives minority brides marriage aid of:
new.x: Shaadi Tohfa (October 2020) gives Rs 1 lakh; the earlier Dulhan scheme gave Rs 50,000.

new.s: In Andhra Pradesh, Backward Classes comprise how many communities in Groups A-E?
new.x: AP's BCs (43.17% of the population) comprise 138 communities in Groups A-E.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about minority welfare in Andhra Pradesh:
1. Andhra Pradesh has a statutory State Minorities Commission.
2. The Dulhan scheme gives Rs 1 lakh to minority brides.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: AP has a statutory State Minorities Commission; Dulhan gives Rs 50,000, while Rs 1 lakh is under Shaadi Tohfa.

new.s: The four Labour Codes together replaced how many central labour laws?
new.x: The four Codes replaced 29 central labour laws.

new.s: Which of the four Labour Codes was enacted in 2019?
new.x: The Code on Wages came in 2019; the other three Codes are of 2020.

new.s: All four Labour Codes came into force on:
new.x: All four Labour Codes came into force on 21 November 2025.

new.s: The Industrial Disputes Act, 1947 has been subsumed into the:
new.x: The Industrial Disputes Act, 1947 went into the Industrial Relations Code.

new.s: Under the Industrial Relations Code, Standing Orders apply to establishments with at least:
new.x: The Standing Orders threshold, like the layoff permission threshold, is 300 workers.

new.s: Which State enacted the first platform-based gig workers law?
new.x: Rajasthan's Platform-Based Gig Workers Act, 2023 was the first; Karnataka followed in 2025.

new.s: The NITI estimate of gig workers in India for 2020-21 was:
new.x: NITI estimated 77 lakh gig workers; the Economic Survey figure is 120 lakh.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about gig workers under the Code on Social Security, 2020:
1. Registration gives them employee status.
2. The Code provides for National and State Social Security Boards.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: The Code sets up National and State Social Security Boards, but registration gives no employee status or minimum wage guarantee.

new.s: NCEUS found that what share of Indians were living on under Rs 20 a day?
new.x: The Arjun Sengupta-led NCEUS found 77% living on under Rs 20 a day.

new.s: The Unorganised Workers' Social Security Act, 2008 set up a:
o: National Commission for Enterprises in the Unorganised Sector
new.x: The 2008 Act set up a National Social Security Board, with welfare schemes listed in Schedule I.

new.s: The entry age for PMJJBY is:
new.x: PMJJBY is the only one with 18-50; PM-SYM, NPS-Traders and APY are 18-40 and PMSBY 18-70.

new.s: Which scheme gives accidental death and disability cover of Rs 2 lakh for Rs 20 a year?
new.x: PMSBY is an accident scheme (Rs 20/year); PMJJBY is life cover for death from any cause (Rs 436/year).

new.s: The wage ceiling for ESIC coverage is:
new.x: The ESI wage ceiling is Rs 21,000 a month (since 2017).

new.s: In September 2026 the EPFO wage ceiling was raised from Rs 15,000 to:
new.x: The EPFO wage ceiling rose from Rs 15,000 to Rs 25,000 in September 2026.

new.s: NPS-Traders is open to traders with an annual turnover up to:
new.x: NPS-Traders (September 2019) covers traders aged 18-40 with turnover up to Rs 1.5 crore.

new.s: The Ashraya Bima Yojana (2001) was meant for:
new.x: Ashraya Bima Yojana (2001, LIC) covered workers who lost their jobs; RSBY was for BPL families.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about PM Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM):
1. Its entry age is 18-40 years.
2. Members of NPS are also eligible for it.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: PM-SYM is for 18-40 year olds; EPFO, ESIC and government-funded NPS members are excluded.

new.s: The e-Shram portal was launched on:
new.x: The Ministry of Labour and Employment launched e-Shram on 26 August 2021.

new.s: Registration on the e-Shram portal is open to unorganised workers aged:
new.x: e-Shram is for unorganised workers aged 16-59 who are not income-tax payers or EPFO/ESIC members.

new.s: About how many workers from Andhra Pradesh were registered on e-Shram as of July 2026?
new.x: AP had 88.8 lakh e-Shram registrations (14 July 2026), out of over 31.78 crore nationally.

new.s: The e-Shram One-Stop Solution (2024) links how many central schemes?
new.x: The 2024 One-Stop Solution links 15 central schemes, such as PM-SVANidhi, PMSBY and PM-SYM.

new.s: The Inter-State Migrant Workmen Act, 1979 has been subsumed into the:
new.x: The 1979 Act went into the Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020, not the Social Security Code.

new.s: Under the Inter-State Migrant Workmen Act, 1979, the displacement allowance was:
new.x: The 1979 Act gave a displacement allowance of 50% of monthly wages plus a journey allowance.

new.s: The OSH Code applies its migrant worker provisions to establishments with at least:
new.x: The OSH Code covers establishments with 10 workers, up from 5 under the 1979 Act.

new.s: Which scheme lets migrant workers draw PDS ration anywhere in India?
new.x: One Nation One Ration Card lets migrants draw PDS ration anywhere in India.

new.s: The Central Sector Scheme for Rehabilitation of Bonded Labourer was launched in:
new.x: The rehabilitation scheme dates from 2016 (revised 2021); the Abolition Act is of 1976.

new.s: The 2021 revision of the bonded labour rehabilitation scheme raised immediate aid to:
new.x: The 2021 revision raised immediate aid to Rs 30,000; the scheme is 100% centrally funded.

new.s: Under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, no filing fee is charged for claims up to:
new.x: Filing is free up to Rs 5 lakh; above that the fee is Rs 200 to Rs 7,500.

new.s: The Consumer Protection Act, 2019 replaced the:
new.x: The 2019 Act replaced the Consumer Protection Act, 1986.

new.s: An appeal against an order of a District Consumer Commission lies to the State Commission within:
new.x: District to State appeals lie within 45 days; State to National and National to Supreme Court within 30 days.

new.s: Under the 2021 Rules, the State Consumer Commission hears complaints valued at:
new.x: The 2021 Rules set District up to Rs 50 lakh, State Rs 50 lakh-2 crore, National above Rs 2 crore; the Rs 1-10 crore slab was the original 2019 one.

new.s: Under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, an endorser of a misleading advertisement may be barred for a first offence for up to:
new.x: An endorser may be barred for up to 1 year, and up to 3 years for a repeat offence.

new.s: The Central Consumer Protection Authority is a(n):
new.x: The CCPA is an executive agency (from 24 July 2020); the Consumer Commissions are quasi-judicial.

new.s: Under the E-Commerce (Amendment) Rules, 2026, the 'prior price' shown must be the lowest price in the preceding:
new.x: The 2026 Rules define prior price as the lowest price in the preceding 30 days.

new.s: In consumer awareness, 'Jagriti' is the name of the:
new.x: Jagriti is the Jago Grahak Jago mascot; the online filing portal is e-Jagriti.

new.s: Which of the following pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
new.x: Eco Mark is for eco-friendly products; Hallmark is for gold and silver.

new.s: Eco Mark for eco-friendly products was introduced in:
new.x: Eco Mark dates from 1991; Agmark is of 1937 and FPO of 1955.

new.s: Hallmarking of gold was made mandatory in:
new.x: Hallmarking of gold became mandatory in June 2021.

new.s: Indian Medical Association v. V.P. Shantha was decided in:
new.x: In IMA v. V.P. Shantha (1995) the Supreme Court held paid medical services to be a 'service'.

new.s: World Consumer Rights Day is observed on:
new.x: World Consumer Rights Day is 15 March; India's National Consumer Day is 24 December.

new.s: The UN Guidelines for Consumer Protection, adopted in 1985, were last revised in:
new.x: The Guidelines were adopted in 1985, widened in 1999 and revised in 2015.
